uat.heading: UAT test run
uat.boundary: This is the UAT environment: all data is synthetic. Publishing only stores a version in UAT; no messages are delivered and no journey runs for real customers.
uat.runLabel: Test run details from the server
uat.journeyPending: The journey is not ready yet
uat.noRun: No test run is open. Press “Start new run” to start the first run.
uat.resultsCaption: Step results recorded by the server
uat.noResults: No results recorded in this run yet
uat.actualHint: Describe what you saw. Never enter real customer data, tokens or passwords.
uat.readOnlyNote: The screen is narrower than 960px, so the test run is view-only. Recording results and starting a new run need a wider screen.
uat.newRunHint: Closes the current run and starts the next one with a new draft journey. Evidence from earlier runs is kept.
uat.confirmCloses: Run {{sequence}} will be closed: COMPLETED if its journey has been published, otherwise ABANDONED, and that journey can no longer be edited.
uat.confirmFirst: No run is open. This starts the first run of this fixture pack.
uat.confirmKeeps: Recorded results and evidence from earlier runs are all kept. Nothing is deleted.
uat.confirmCreates: A new draft journey is created from the fixture pack baseline and opened for you.
uat.sessionExpiredBody: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue testing. Results you already recorded are safe on the server.

error.network: Could not reach the server, so the command outcome is unknown
error.UAT_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: This account is not the fixture pack's maker, so it cannot start a new run
error.UAT_RUN_NOT_FOUND: This test run was not found, or you are not a tester of this run
error.FIXTURE_PACK_NOT_FOUND: No fixture pack matches the given environment and version
error.FIXTURE_PACK_DIGEST_MISMATCH: The fixture pack does not match the provisioned one
error.FIXTURE_PREFLIGHT_FAILED: The fixture pack failed its readiness check
error.REVISION_CONFLICT: Another command already changed the test run. The latest data has been loaded.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This command was already sent with different data
error.UAT_RUN_CLOSED: This test run is closed, so no more results can be recorded
error.UAT_RUN_PENDING_REVIEW: Cannot start a new run: this run's journey still has a review pending
error.UAT_RUN_PENDING_PUBLISH: Cannot start a new run: this run's journey is approved but not published
error.UAT_RUN_MUTATION_IN_FLIGHT: Cannot start a new run: a command is still pending
error.REQUEST_MALFORMED: The request is incomplete or malformed: {{field}}
error.EVIDENCE_TYPE_REJECTED: Only PNG/JPEG screenshots are accepted. Traces, HAR files, network logs and other files are rejected.
error.EVIDENCE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 5 MB
error.EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND: This screenshot was not found or its retention has expired
error.EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED: The stored screenshot does not match its recorded digest

nextAction.DECIDE_REVIEW: Have a reviewer decide the pending review of this run's journey, then start a new run.
nextAction.PUBLISH_OR_EDIT_DRAFT: Publish this run's journey, or edit the draft to withdraw the approval, then start a new run.
nextAction.RESOLVE_PENDING_COMMAND: Open this run's journey and check the pending command (for example, check the publish outcome) first.
nextAction.RETRY_START: Press “Start new run” again to finish the pending command.
nextAction.RELOAD_RUN: Check the latest run details above, then try again if still needed.
nextAction.SUBMIT_AGAIN: Check the data and send it again.
nextAction.ASK_MAKER: Ask the fixture pack's maker to start the new run.
nextAction.CHECK_PACK: Check the fixture pack environment and version with the UAT operator.
nextAction.ASK_OPERATOR: Ask the UAT operator to check the fixture pack.
nextAction.FIX_FIELD: Fix the named field and send again.
nextAction.RETRY_SAME: Press again. The same command is resent and will not be recorded twice.
nextAction.CHOOSE_SCREENSHOT: Choose a PNG or JPEG screenshot up to 5 MB and upload again.

evidence.heading: Screenshot evidence
evidence.hint: Only PNG/JPEG screenshots up to 5 MB are accepted and kept in UAT private storage for 90 days. Never attach Playwright traces, HAR files or network logs, and never capture tokens, passwords or real customer data.
evidence.fileHint: PNG or JPEG only. The server checks the file type from its content.
evidence.none: No screenshots in this run yet
evidence.caption: Screenshot evidence of this run with digests
evidence.exported: Exported the evidence bundle. Overall result: {{verdict}}

publish.sending: Waiting for the server to confirm…
